text: Mary Saotome
Yumeko Jabami
{character:Kirari Momobami}…
Wanjirou
Miki Nikaidou
Midari Ikishima
{character:Wanjirou}Woof... I can't take it anymore. I give up, woof...
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Mr. Wanjirou's mouth is all swollen. Here, have a cup of water.
{character:Wanjirou}Thanks, woof...
{character:Wanjirou}(What happened... I was on a roll... Why did I lose so hard once bets got involved, woof...)
{character:Midari Ikishima}Tsk, it's just because you suck. Because of you, I didn't taste that deadly, spicy pain. Get your head in the game, silly dog, or I might kill you!
{character:Wanjirou}Yes, I suck, woof... (dejected)
{character:Midari Ikishima}Tsk, hurry up. Let's start the next game.
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Wanjirou looks done for. I would like to take a break, too. Excuse me.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}It's finished, then. What a bummer, I was having a hot hand.
{character:Kirari Momobami}Excuse me.
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Ah, you're back, Kirari. How do you like the night view in the Mahjong Soul Shrine?
{character:Kirari Momobami}Not bad. I loved the evening breeze.
{character:Miki Nikaidou}As for the other one, you must be tired. Looks like you didn't find your way back, did you?
{character:Mary Saotome}... You already knew the answer to that. Why bother asking?
Kirari Momobami
{character:Mary Saotome}Tsk, of course you are here.
{character:Midari Ikishima}Hehe, President, are you interested in joining us too?
{character:Mary Saotome}I don't have as much spare time as you. Let's stop wasting time and play.
{character:Mary Saotome}It was her order. God knows what would happen to me if I disobeyed her.
{character:Kirari Momobami}I don't remember saying anything like that.
{character:Mary Saotome}Wait! You trust this woman? Who are you with?
{character:Yumeko Jabami}I've always been with the ones who enjoy gambling.
{character:Midari Ikishima}Stop it, Saotome. Yumeko saw right through you. She's not stupid.
{character:Mary Saotome}The president says this is a place where our mahjong skills do all the talking. If anyone wants to leave, they could try winning on the mahjong table.
{character:Wanjirou}Woof woof woof? This is indeed a place where people are judged by their mahjong skills, but as for the 'winning' part... Woof?
"Don't tell her yet. I have my reasons."
"Now this is where the fun begins. So, let's enjoy the game first."
After reading Momobami's lips, Wanjirou abruptly swallowed the words he was going to say.
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Wanjirou, you don't want to ruin the mood, do you?
{character:Wanjirou}... Okay, okay. I understand, woof.
{character:Mary Saotome}What's the matter? You look suspicious.
{character:Midari Ikishima}What's the hurry, Saotome... You should take your time and have fun. Hehe, or could it be that you just can't wait to taste the pleasure of getting destroyed?
{character:Mary Saotome}I'm not interested in that kind of thing. I play to win.
{character:Mary Saotome}If we keep wasting time like this, we'll get fined for not finishing the topic. I don't have money for that...
{character:Mary Saotome}Damnit, what's wrong with these people…?
{character:Mary Saotome}(One is already enough. And now I've got three. If I were a rookie like Suzui, I'd be so nervous that I'd already been puking in the bathroom.)
{character:Mary Saotome}(... Stop thinking about it. No matter who I'm facing, I need to win! Win and go back to where I came from!)
{character:Miki Nikaidou}... Let's go, Wanjirou.
{character:Wanjirou}What? You don't want to watch them for a while? These four are all experts. Should be fun to watch, woof.
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Watching the game is fine, but... Take a good look at them.
{character:Mary&Yumeko}…//n…
{character:Kirari&Midari}……//nHehe...
Kirari&Midari
Feeling the tense atmosphere, Wanjirou and Miki left quietly.
It's already late, but for these gamblers, the evening has only just begun…
{character:Yumeko Jabami}President, Mary. You guys are here, too.
{character:Kirari Momobami}Mary said you're here, too. I thought it would be quite fun for the four of us to play together.
{character:Kirari Momobami}The game is definitely going to be fun, right, Mary?
{character:Yumeko Jabami}But Mary. weren't you in a rush to leave? Why did you come back?
{character:Yumeko Jabami}President and Mary still don't know the new rules, right? Let me explain, then. First...
Mary&Yumeko
{character:Miki Nikaidou}(It's not that they are too 'powerful'. More like Wanjirou was just overwhelmed by their enthusiasm.)
{character:Wanjirou}The girl who came earlier was also unbeatable. Are high school girls all so powerful nowadays?! Woof?!
{character:Miki Nikaidou}It's alright! You've got some better opponents here.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Mr. Wanjirou, are you alright? If you are, let's start the next game!
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Oh! So Mary's the one who wants to play.
{character:Mary Saotome}Eww, she's indulging in her imagination again... Yes, I came because I wanted to. But not just for fun.
{character:Mary Saotome}Never mind. Let's start already! The earlier we start, the earlier we finish!
{character:Midari Ikishima}Tsk, that's a poor person problem.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}The new rules are pretty interesting, Mary. Let's have some fun!
{character:Miki Nikaidou}Although it might be a brilliant battle to behold, it's a duel within the 'Bami' family. If you're not careful, you might get caught up in this madness.
{character:Wanjirou}Even though I don't know what a 'Bami' is, staying here doesn't seem like a good idea, woof. Let's go...

{character:Midari Ikishima}This is the chance of a lifetime to play with both of them together. No one would let go of such a rare chance. Getting down on them simultaneously... Hehe, hehehe... I can't wait!
"I'll just try my best!" Mary takes a deep breath and encourages herself.
{character:Wanjirou}Woof? Woof?! Woof... (scared)
